BEFORE WE GO

Just a little planning

Altitude and cold. San Cristóbal is at about 2,200 m. Days are mild; nights are cold, and most places have no heating. Pack layers and warm socks.

Getting around. The centre is walkable. Colectivos to Chamula and Zinacantán leave from near the market, about 25 pesos a ride. Taxis are cash only: agree the price first.

Book ahead. The Sumidero tour and the Chamula tour for the two Saturdays. Write to Brooke for Xmal’s contact, for the cacao ceremony, before we arrive.

Roads in Chiapas can be blocked at short notice. Check the day before any long trip.

Support local women

If you can afford to and would like to, consider donating to Red Nacional de Refugios to support women and children experiencing domestic violence.

I don’t receive any money or commission from these donations. Supporting local women matters to me, and this is one small way to give back to the places I visit. It takes all of us to stand against gender-based and domestic violence.
